title: Eric's LinkedIn Pulse — 'You Can't Inspect an AI. You Can Watch How Its Makers Treat People.'
summary: Eric publishes a long-form LinkedIn Pulse article extending Incorruptible's central argument into the AI age — that because the systems themselves are opaque to external scrutiny, the trustworthiness signal we have is how the companies building them treat the people around them.
blockquote: You do not have power over these companies. You cannot inspect their systems. All you can do is judge the people offering them.
